strings.seo.faq[0].a: Ewe. Zonke izixhobo zisimahla, zingenalophawu lwasemanzini kwaye akukho nto itshixiweyo emva kwentlawulo yorhweliso. Akukho khadi letyala elicelwayo naphakade.

strings.seo.faq[2].a: Hayi. Iifayile zakho zisetyenziselwa kuphela umsebenzi owucelileyo, ze zicinywe. Akukho bani uzifundayo kwaye azabelaniwa naphakade.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Ewe. I-pdffusion isebenza kwisiphequluli sayo nayiphi na ifowuni, ithebhulethi okanye ikhompyutha (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), ngaphandle kokufaka naluphi na ufakelo.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: I-PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, imifanekiso (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC (iPhone), TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML nangaphezulu.

strings.privacy.title: Ubumfihlo
strings.privacy.description: Indlela i-pdffusion ephatha ngayo iifayile zakho: akukho akhawunti, akukho xwebhu lugciniweyo, akukho ntengiso kunye nokuthengiswa kwedatha.
strings.privacy.intro: I-pdffusion yakhelwe ukwenzela ukuba amaxwebhu akho ahlale yeyakho. Nantsi, ngamagama acacileyo, okwenzekayo xa uyisebenzisa.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Iifayile zakho
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Zithunyelwa zifihliwe (HTTPS), zicutshungulwe ngokuzenzekelayo, ze zicinywe kwakuba isiphumo silungile. Iifayile ezinkulu zidlula kwindawo yogcino lwexesha elifutshane phantsi kwegama elingacwangciswanga kwaye zicinywa kwangoko xa inkqubo iphela; ucociso oluzenzekelayo lususa nayiphi na into enokuhlala ngaphakathi kweyure ezingama-24 ubuninzi.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Akukho akhawunti, akukho datha yobuqu
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: I-pdffusion ayiceli kubhalisa, idilesi ye-imeyile okanye ikhadi letyala. Amaxwebhu akho awakhe afundwe, ahlalutywe, abelane ngayo okanye asetyenziselwe ukuqeqesha ubulumko bokwenziwa (AI).
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Ulinganiso lwabaphulaphuli
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Sibala utyelelo ngaphandle kokwaziwa nangaphandle kweekuki (Vercel Web Analytics) ukuze sifunde ukuba ziziphi izixhobo eziluncedo. Akukho ntengiso, akukho ulandelelo lwamawebhu.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Iikuki (Cookies)
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Ikuki enye, enokukhethwa: ikhumbula ulwimi olukhethileyo.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Ukusingatha (Hosting)
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Isiza singathwa yi-Vercel kwiiseva zaseParis; ukuguqulwa kwe-Word, Excel kunye ne-PowerPoint kuphathwa yi-Render eFrankfurt. Aba banikezeli baphatha kuphela iifayile ngexesha lokuguqula.

strings.legal.terms.description: I-pdffusion imahala kumntu wonke, kuquka amashishini noorhulumente. Amaxwebhu akho ahlala eng awakho: akukho nto ihlalutywayo okanye igcinwe.
strings.legal.terms.intro: Le mimiselo ilawula ukusebenzisa kwakho i-pdffusion. Imfutshane kwaye ibhalwe ngolwimi olulula. Ngokusebenzisa isiza, uyayamkela.
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].title: Ngubani opapasha i-pdffusion
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].text: I-pdffusion yenzelwe, yakhiwa yaza yapapashwa nguMikailou Cedric Toure, umphuhlisi ozinze eNew Brunswick, eCanada.
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].title: Ilayisensi yasimahla yokusebenzisa, kumntu wonke
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].text: I-pdffusion imahala, ngaphandle kobhaliso kwaye ngaphandle komda wexesha, kumntu wonke: abantu abaqhelekileyo, abafundi, otitshala, amashishini, imibutano engenenzuzo, amaqumrhu karhulumente noorhulumente, eCanada nakweliphi na elinye ilizwe. Akukho kusetyenziswa kugcinelwe isicwangciso esihlawulelwayo, kuba asikho. Iifayili ovelisa zona zizezakho ngokupheleleyo: aziphethe uphawu lwasamanzi kwaye akukho kukhankanywa kwe-pdffusion.
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].title: Onke amaxwebhu akho, nangenqobo eyimfihlo
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].text: Ungaqhuba naluphi na uhlobo loxwebhu, kuquka oluyimfihlo, kuba i-pdffusion ayifundi, ihlalutye, igcine okanye yabelane ngeefayili zakho: ziqhutywa ngokuzenzekelayo zize zicinywe. Uhlala ungumnini wazo, kwaye unoxanduva lokuba namamalungelo afunekayo ukuze uziqhube.
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].title: Ikhowudi yomthombo kunye nofakelo kuseva yakho
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].text: Ikhowudi yomthombo ye-pdffusion ipapashwe phantsi kwelayisensi ye-MIT. Ungayifunda, uyihlole, uyifake kuseva yakho (kuquka kwinethiwekhi evaliweyo engenakho ukuvula i-Intanethi), uyilungise kwaye uyihambise simahla, phantsi kwemiqathango yokuba ugcina isaziso selayisensi kunye nesicatshulwa selayisensi.
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].title: Ukusetyenziswa okwamkelekileyo
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].text: Awunakusebenzisa i-pdffusion kwizenzo ezingekho mthethweni, uzame ukuphazamisa inkonzo (ukulayishwa okuninzi okuzenzekelayo, iinzame zokungena) okanye ugqithise imida yayo yezobugcisa. Ubungakanani nemida yenani lefayili ikhusela inkonzo kumntu wonke.
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].title: Ukufumaneka
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].text: I-pdffusion inikezelwa simahla. Inokutshintsha, iphazanyiswe ukulungiselela ulondolozo okanye iyekwe. Soloko ugcina amaxwebhu akho okuqala: i-pdffusion ayigcini kopa wazo.
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].title: Iwaranti noxanduva
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].text: Inkonzo inikezelwa “njengoko injalo”, ngaphandle ewaranti yaluphi na uhlobo. Ngokomlinganiselo omkhulu ovunyelwe yimithetho, umpapashi akanoxanduva lomonakalo ongathe ngqo, ukulahleka kwedatha okanye isiphumo soguqulo esingenelanga. Jonga amaxwebhu owavelisayo phambi kokuba uwasebenzisele nantoni na ebalulekileyo.
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].title: Ubini bolwazi
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].text: Igama le-pdffusion, ilogo yayo nezicatshulwa zesiza zingezompapashi; ikhowudi ipantsi kwelayisensi ye-MIT njengoko kuchaziwe ngasentla. Iimpawu zorhwebo ezikhankanyiweyo (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint…) zingezabanini bazo.
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].title: Umthetho olawulayo
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].text: Le mimiselo ilawulwa yimithetho yePhondo laseNew Brunswick kunye nemithetho yaseburhulumenteni yaseCanada esebenza kuyo. Iinkundla zaseNew Brunswick zinegunya, ngaphandle kokonakalisa amalungelo owanikwa ngumthetho welizwe lakho njengomthengi.

strings.legal.terms.sections[9].text: Le mimiselo inokuhlaziywa. Umhla ophezulu kwiphepha ubonisa inguqulelo esebenzayo; utshintsho lusebenza kuphela ekusetyenzisweni emva kokuba lupapashiwe.

strings.legal.security.title: Ukhuseleko kunye nedatha
strings.legal.security.description: Kwenteka ntoni kwiifayili zakho kwi-pdffusion: ukulungiswa okuzenzekelayo, akukho hlalutyo, ukucinywa ngoko nangoko, ubethelelo, ukusingathwa eYurophu, kunye nokhetho lokuyifaka kuseva yakho.
strings.legal.security.intro: Kwenteka ntoni kwiifayili zakho, ziphi apho ziqhutywa khona kwaye zikhuselwa njani: kuchazwe ngokulula, kubantu ngabanye nakumasebe e-IT ngokufanayo.
strings.legal.security.sections[0].title: Akukho maxwebhu agcinwayo
strings.legal.security.sections[0].text: Iifayili zakho ziqhutywa ngokuzenzekelayo, zize zicinywe kwakamsinya nje ukuba isiphumo silungile okanye sikhutshelwe. Akukho kopa, akukho gciniso nangamaxesha adlulileyo. Ukucocwa okuzenzekelayo kwemihla ngemihla kukwahlela nayiphi na ifayili yexeshana enokuhlala, ngosuku olulandelayo kwakamva nje.
strings.legal.security.sections[1].title: Akukho hlalutyo
strings.legal.security.sections[1].text: Akukho mntu ufunda amaxwebhu akho. Akabhalwa kuluhlu, ahlalutywa, abelwane ngawo okanye asetyenziselwe ukuqeqesha ubulumko bokwenziwa. I-pdffusion ayinamakhontsho, akukho zintengiso kwaye akukho maprofayili abasebenzisi.
strings.legal.security.sections[2].title: Ubethelelo
strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: Yonke uqhagamshelwano lubethelelwe (HTTPS) kwaye isiza sinyanzelisa ubethelelo kuyo yonke utyelelo (HSTS). Isixhobo sokukhusela sibethelela ii-PDF zakho nge-AES-256; igama lokugqitha olikhethayo aligcinwa nini.
strings.legal.security.sections[3].title: Apho iifayili zakho ziqhutywa khona
strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Isiza, izixhobo ze-PDF kunye nemifanekiso: i-Vercel, iziko ledatha laseParis (Fransi, iManyano yaseYurophu). Ukuguqulwa kwe-Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint: i-Render, eFrankfurt (Jalimani, iManyano yaseYurophu). Iifayili ezingaphezu kwe-4 MB: ugcino lwesikhashana lwe-Vercel Blob, phantsi kwegama elingaziwayo, elisusiweyo emva kokusetyenziswa.
strings.legal.security.sections[4].title: Ukhuseleko lwezobugcisa
strings.legal.security.sections[4].text: Iintloko zokhuseleko (HSTS, ukuvimba isiza ukuba singafakwa kwamanye amaphepha, ukukhuselwa ekudidekeni kohlobo lwefayili), iidilesi zefayili zexeshana ezingenakuqikelelwa, kunye nenkonzo yoguqulelo eyamkela kuphela izicelo eziphethe ithokheni eyimfihlo. Yonke utshintsho lwekhowudi luhlwaywa ngokuzenzekelayo (iimvavanyo, ukuhlwaya iindidi) phambi kokuba luphile.
strings.legal.security.sections[5].title: Imfihlo nomthetho osebenzayo
strings.legal.security.sections[5].text: I-pdffusion ipapashwe eNew Brunswick kwaye ithobela uMthetho woKhuseleko lweNgcaciso yoBuqu kunye namaXwebhu aseMbane (PIPEDA) waseCanada. Ayiqokeleli nkcazelo yobuqu ngabasebenzisi bayo: akukho akhawunti, akukho dilesi ye-imeyile, akukho khuki yokulandela. Yakhelwe kwimisebenzi efanayo ne-GDPR yaseYurophu kunye noMthetho 25 waseQuébec: ukuncitshiswa kwedatha, akukho kusebenzisa kwakhona, ukucinywa emva kwesicelo.
strings.legal.security.sections[6].title: Kumaziko anemigaqo engqongqo
strings.legal.security.sections[6].text: Ukuba imigaqo yakho iyakuvalela ukuthumela amaxwebhu kwinkonzo yangaphandle, faka i-pdffusion kuseva yakho. Isoftware epheleleyo imahala, ingumthombo ovulelekileyo kwaye isebenza ngaphandle koqhagamshelwano lwe-Intanethi: akukho fayili ishiya inethiwekhi yakho. Isikhokelo sofakelo sikwiphepha leprojekthi.

strings.legal.security.sections[7].text: Ikhowudi yomthombo epheleleyo iselubala: amaqela akho okhuseleko anokuqinisekisa ngasinye sale mibono.

strings.legal.accessibility.title: Ukufikeleleka
strings.legal.accessibility.description: Isiteamenti sokufikeleleka se-pdffusion: iqhinga le-WCAG 2.2 yamanqanaba AA, amanyathelo akhoyo, imida eyaziwayo nendlela yokuxela umqobo.
strings.legal.accessibility.intro: Umntu wonke kufuneka akwazi ukusebenzisa i-pdffusion, kuquka abantu abangaboniyo okanye abanobuthathaka bokubona, abangeva kakuhle, okanye abanengxaki yokuhamba okanye yengqondo.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].title: Umgangatho ojoliswe kuwo
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: I-pdffusion ijolise ukuthobela iMithetho yoKufikeleleka koMxholo weWebhu (WCAG) 2.2, inqanaba AA, umgangatho wamazwe ngamazwe we-W3C. Eli nqanaba ligubungela iimfuneko zoMgangatho woKufikeleleka koXwebhu woRhulumente waseCanada, umgangatho waseYurophu EN 301 549 kunye neCandelo 508 eUnited States, ezibhekisa kwi-WCAG 2.0 okanye 2.1 inqanaba AA.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].title: Ubunqobo bokuthobela
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: I-pdffusion ithobela ngokuyinxenye i-WCAG 2.2 inqanaba AA: imida eyaziwayo idweliswe ngezantsi. Olu xwebhu lusekelwe kuvavanyo lwangaphakathi olwenziwe ngo-Oktobha 2, 2026, lusebenzisa izixhobo ezizenzekelayo (i-axe, i-Lighthouse) kunye nokuhlola ngesandla (ibhodi enqabileyo, umahluko, ukukhulisa, izibhengezo). Akukho phononongo oluzimeleyo olwenziweyo okwangoku.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: Okukhoyo
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Lonke isiza lisebenza ngebhodi enqabileyo, kunye “nomkhondo wokutsiba uye kwisiqulatho” kunye nomgca obonakalayo kwinto esebenzayo. Umahluko wesicatshulwa ubuncinane ungu-4.5:1. Amanyathelo omsebenzi (ukulayisha, isiphumo, impazamo) abhengezwa kubafundi bezikrini. Ulandelwano lwefayili lunokutshintshwa ngaphandle kokurhuqa nokulahla, kusetyenziswa amaqhosha. Isiza silandela setting “yokunciphisa ukuhamba” yesixhobo sakho: i michiza emva koko iyeka ngokupheleleyo. Amaphepha ahlala efundeka kwi-zoom engama-400% nasemakhikhi. Ulwimi lwephandle ngalinye liyabhengezwa, kwaye isi-Arabhu siboniswa ukusuka ngasekunene ukuya ngasekhohlo.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].title: Imida eyaziwayo
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].text: Ngaphandle kwaloo seti, oopopayi bokuhombisa (isithembisi sangasemva, iringi, itikha yefomati) basebenza ngokuqhubekayo; itikha iyama xa ujikeleza ngaphezulu nangokugxila kwekhibhodi. Iringi epopayisiweyo ekwiphe halamanqinda isetyenziswa ngemawusi ya okanye ngomnwe; iyandaweni yokuhombisa, kwaye uluhlu lweefomati ezibonisayo lukhona nakwiphepha njengesicatshulwa. Iilwimi ezitolikwe ngoomatshini zinokuba neempazamo. Okokugqibela, ukufikeleleka koxwebhu oluvelisiweyo kuxhomekeke kowokuqala: i-pdffusion ayongezi iithegi zokufikeleleka ku-PDF engenanto.

strings.legal.install.title: I-pdffusion yamaziko
strings.legal.install.description: Faka i-pdffusion kuseva yorhulumente okanye inkampani yakho: simahla, ngumthombo ovulelekileyo, kwaye amaxwebhu akho awashiyi inethiwekhi yakho.
strings.legal.install.intro: Oorhulumente, amashishini, izibhedlele, izikole: faka i-pdffusion ngaphakathi ngemizuzu kwaye ugcine ulawulo oluphelele lwamaxwebhu akho.
strings.legal.install.sections[0].title: Amaxwebhu akho ahlala kwinethiwekhi yakho
strings.legal.install.sections[0].text: Konke ukulungiswa kwenzeka kuseva yakho, nangenqobo yokuba akukho kuqhagamshelwano lwe-Intanethi. Akukho nkcazelo yohlalutyo, akukho nkonzo yangaphandle, akukho makhontsho.

strings.legal.install.sections[1].text: Yonke isixhobo se-pdffusion, ngaphezu kweefomethi ezingama-40, i-LibreOffice ye-Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint, kunye nazo zonke iilwimi zojongano ezingama-160, kwisikhongozeli esinye.
strings.legal.install.sections[2].title: Simahla kwaye ngumthombo ovulelekileyo

strings.tools.ocr.seoDescription: Funda isicatshulwa sePDF eskeniweyo okanye ifoto (OCR) ukuze ukwazi ukuyikhangela, uyikope okanye uyifunde ngokuvakalayo. Iilwimi ezili-16, mahhala, uxwebhu alulayishwa.
strings.tools.ocr.intro: Uxwebhu oluskeniweyo okanye olufotweyo ngumfanekiso nje: awukwazi kukhangela igama okanye ukukopa isivakalisi. Funda isikeni siqaphela onke oonobumba (oku kubizwa ngokuba yi-OCR) kwaye yongeza isicatshulwa sokwenyani kuxwebhu ngaphandle kokuqhubela phambili indlela ebonakala ngayo. Ukufunda kwenzeka kwisixhobo sakho: uxwebhu lwakho alulayishwa. Yimodeli kuphela yolwimi olukhethiweyo (i-MB ezimbalwa) ekhutshelwa kanye.
